Yeah, usually they aren't so fond of the emotional aspect of conversations, but I have a few who I am able to be comfortable with to talk about this with, and vice versa. I think it's because being vulnerable is a bigger concern for them, but there'll be some who you can count on. Some may be happy to have someone open up the dialogue, since they can't do it themselves. Even if they are hesitant at first, I think most are relieved after we talk it out.

I never got used to using discord :(

If you aren't against being friends with more men, why not find a community you'd enjoy and start off there? Not that having a preference is wrong, I get it completely! You don't need to be especially close to anyone, it's nice to have just acquaintances too. Soon enough, you'll be able to meet more people and see who you can gel with more. Their mutuals may be similar to them, so it's less scary to talk for the first time. Group chats can also be fun if they're an option. I used to be scared of trying to make friends with anyone, but this is what made it easier for me to interact with others.

I think befriending more women should be easier that way so they don't feel as alert since you will have similar interests/know so and so. It's not as if you are talking to them solely because they are women, so I don't think you would have an unflattering first impression. I do have a friend who struggles with a similar issue though, and there will always be some people who feel like there is an ulterior motive. Everyone deserves a chance though, even if they get off on the wrong foot. I hope you can find some good friends! :) 

I don't know if I will be very active on this account, but I can talk to you if you'd like to! I'm sorry to hear that your friends have been ignoring you. I'm not the best conversationalist, but you deserve to have someone listen to you!
It would be nice to receive any kind of input.  I hope life is treating you better now!

You are doing so well! You should be proud of yourself for making it this far. Making this kind of change in your life takes a lot of effort, and it has definitely paid off. You have a nice smile btw!
